note: Flagged items do not block the merge. Each item says what is unverified and how to close it.

items.title: Caesars Palace buy-in conflict
items.detail: caesars.com page lists $100 for all four daily events; the official 2026 flyer lists $100 (10 AM, 6 PM) and $160 (2 PM, 9 PM). The flyer is used. Confirm at the poker room.

items.title: MGM Grand daily tournaments: times and buy-ins
items.detail: Official page lists NLH tournaments at 11 AM, 7 PM, 11 PM. A third-party source lists 11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM, 11 PM and says tournaments were suspended until July 10, 2026. Buy-ins not on the official page. Left blank.

items.title: Horseshoe daily tournaments: times and buy-ins
items.detail: Official page confirms six daily tournament times, but the times and buy-ins are not on the page. Left blank.

items.title: Wynn daily poster: guarantee-to-day mapping
items.detail: The poster (June 2026 revision) shows Mon-Thu and Sat/Sun guarantees, but the day mapping is ambiguous and the poster was not checked against the current schedule. Daily rows have no dates.

items.title: Wynn WPT schedule: formatting and footnotes
items.detail: Rows for Dec 17-18 are out of order. The 'NIH' label on Ladies NLH is a typo, read as NLH. Footnoted events (*, **, ***, ****) need structure-sheet checks, which were not done.

items.title: Wynn WPT World Championship eligibility
items.detail: The source note lists the $10,400 events as ClubWPT Gold qualifier-style events, not Nevada entries. Confirm eligibility before entering.

items.title: Venetian rows with missing or inferred dates
items.detail: Several rows (events #47 1A, #49 1A, #58) have a tour label in the date column. Their dates were not captured and are left blank, or are inferred from block order and marked for confirmation.

items.title: Venetian Dec 8 LIPS Ladies row
items.detail: The event is listed on the Dec 8 row, but its buy-in and guarantee were not captured. Left blank.

items.title: Venetian Dec 9 rows only partly captured
items.detail: Only partial rows for Dec 9 were captured. Re-check the full schedule before using Dec 9 for planning.

items.title: Venetian guarantees not captured
items.detail: Events #3-5 RaceDay Stack and #6 ($200 NLH 1-day) show no guarantee in the captured rows. Left blank.

items.title: Venetian later series not scheduled
items.detail: DeepStack NYE (Dec 24, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027) and DeepStack Showdown (Jan 11 - Feb 14, 2027) are announced, but their event schedules were not read.

items.title: Venetian structure sheets
items.detail: Structure sheets read for $200 bounty (structure_1), $400 NLH with $75K GTD (structure_2) and $300 NLH 1-day with $10K GTD (structure_5). Event numbers were not confirmed on the sheets; the buy-in and GTD match the schedule rows for events #2 and #7.

items.title: Venetian PKO label
items.detail: Event #8 is labeled PKO on the schedule; structure_1 is a $200 bounty sheet. Format not confirmed.

items.title: Venetian Turbo flight (1F)
items.detail: The 1F Turbo flight ($800 NLH, $500K GTD, Dec 5) is part of event #26 (row V20 in tournaments.json). Its exact time was not re-checked against the PDF in this session.

items.title: MGM Grand resort fee
items.detail: Only third-party sources report $50 plus tax per night. Official MGM Grand terms not read. Left blank.

items.title: Caesars Palace resort fee and event date range
items.detail: No official resort-fee page read. The daily flyer does not give a date range in the captured text. Left blank.

items.title: Wynn resort fee
items.detail: Official resort-fee page could not be read. Left blank.

items.title: Bellagio poker page
items.detail: Official poker page returned 'Page not found'. No official current tournament data was found.

items.title: ARIA tournaments
items.detail: Official ARIA poker page has room information but no schedule or buy-in. Third-party sources mention a daily $200 NL and an Aria Poker Open. Unverified; not listed.

items.title: Planet Hollywood poker
items.detail: Official poker page returned HTTP 500. Third-party sources report the resort closed in January 2026. Not listed.

items.title: Resorts World poker
items.detail: No official tournament page found. Third-party sources conflict ($160 vs $200). Not listed.

items.title: Golden Nugget, Orleans and South Point
items.detail: Golden Nugget poker page returned empty content; Orleans poker page returned 404; South Point is in the southwest valley (off the Strip, per its home page) and its poker room page was not read. Not listed.

items.title: No verified walking times
items.detail: No walking-time source was read for any hotel or venue. The 30-minute walking limit is therefore unconfirmed for every hotel.

items.title: Repo review: irregularities
items.detail: Repo holds only README.md (one line) and one commit. No LICENSE, no .gitignore, no data or site files. GitHub Pages was set to a legacy build from main root, which had no site files, so the published page was empty. Fixed in this session by serving from /docs.

items.title: Hotel snapshot is a single dated booking
items.detail: The Venetian all-in figure is from one booking-page snapshot (Dec 18-20, 2026, 2 adults), not a live or confirmed rate.

items.title: Wynn Signature Series
items.detail: Jan 11-24, 2027 series is outside the current window. Its schedule PDF was not read.

items.title: Live event timing
items.detail: Venetian event #1 started Nov 16, 2026 (today). Registration close times for the Nov 16-17 flights are not captured.

items.title: Wynn WPT structure sheets
items.detail: Structure PDF was not read beyond its general terms. Blinds, levels and re-entry rules for the WPT events are unverified.
